newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria seeks 150,000 tns optional durum - traders.
newsitem.headline: Algeria seeks 150,000 tns optional durum - traders.

text.p: Algeria will tender on June 3 to purchase 150,000 tonnes of optional durum wheat for shipment in July and August, European grain traders said on Monday.
"Offers will be placed on Tuesday, with results expected on Thursday," one exporter said.

Algeria is seeking 50,000 tonnes for shipment in the first half of July, 50,000 tonnes for shipment in the second half of that month and another 50,000 tonnes for shipment in the first half of August. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
